verdicts.decision_note: The freelancer explicitly commits to including relevant images in response to the client's every-blog-article request, establishing the rendered content requirement.
The client makes adding images a concrete acceptance condition that must be satisfied before blog publication.
The client explicitly requires three to four images in the stuffed-dolls blog, changing its rendered content specification.
The client explicitly requires three to four pictures in the referenced blog and requires those pictures to remain in its published content.
